positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Was responsible for maintenance, optimization,  and enhancement of major company product (BlueCherry). This included working on the database level (MS SQL Server) as well as the front end. This entailed writing business logic, creating stored procedures, database design, GUI design and general debugging. This is an ERP application used in the apparel business; various modules consisting of Product Lifecycle Management, Advanced Warehouse Management Systems, BI, and EDI. 

Developed project tracking tool – a Java based application analyzing maintenance request queue to balance workload and expedite fixes. This took data from various sources and integrated them, allowing management to gain insight into resource allocation and bottlenecks.

positions.title: Systems/Application Analyst
positions.description: Responsible for implementing hardware and software needs.  Installed database (MySQL) and web server (Sun Glassfish). Designed database and J2EE web application to enhance legacy applications. Some EDI.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed in house software applications using Visual FoxPro, java, VBA, Visual basic. Used Microsoft SQL Server for back-end.
